places.quote: it was augmented and rendered sublime by the mighty Alps
My wanderings were directed towards the valley of Chamounix.
places.note: Spelled Chamounix in the 1831 text; the valley is in Haute-Savoie.

places.quote: as I plunged yet deeper in the ravine of Arve
places.note: Named for the Arve river; the ravine is a valley, not a separate water body.

places.quote: the impetuous Arve, and cottages every here and there
places.note: Same river as 'ravine of Arve'; listed once here as the river.

places.quote: here in this land of peace and beauty, your native country, we may reap every tranquil blessing
places.note: Identified only by reference to Victor's native land; the text does not name it.
